title: Not My Style
text: Not My Style. Kind of crude and rustic.  Has a rope wrapped handle that you don't really see in the picture.  Fairly large and of an undetermined style. No price listed, but I can guarantee it isn't worth it. Moderate quality. If it had a lid it would be a good birdcage. Actually I think I might put a vining plant in it.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Farmhouse Metal Jar and Rope Candle Holder Home Decor - 12 x 8.25 x 19 Inches, Grey
features: This galvanized metal candle holder makes a great vintage style statement even when not in use. The rope handle adds to its rustic charm, making it easy to move to the center of the action when it's time to light the candle at your next gathering.
